editorial.blurb: Mela brings together pizza, tacos, and curry with genuinely fantastic food and warmth that makes you feel like family—the kind of place where the owners will feed you even before they're officially open.
editorial.insiderTip: Go late night for quick, well-spiced bites like the massive veggie samosas, or build your own pizza and pair it with their stellar chicken tikka masala and garlic naan.

topDishes.note: massive, extremely well spiced, and priced fairly
